about.tagline: Discord Rich Presence for Nintendo Switch
about.privacy_body: The relay receives your Discord link, the current game name, elapsed time and the icon hash. A game set to Playing a game sends no name, title id or icon, and a Hidden game sends nothing. It keeps no play history and never sees your Discord password.
